conditions.settling: Observe at least 7s and wait up to 30s for loaded fonts and two frames; resume complete pairs without rerunning them
conditions.external: DNS blocked; visitor location stubbed using CDP Fetch; no Playwright routing
conditions.cache: cold=new context; warm=new page in same context after cold visit; HTTP cache enabled
conditions.fontMetric: DOMContentLoaded then document.fonts.ready + two requestAnimationFrame callbacks; readiness proxy, not direct glyph paint timestamp
